# Shiftora

> Shiftora is an integrated strategy and systems firm. It works where institutional direction or responsibility exceeds the operating capacity available to carry it out.

Shiftora holds a mandate from institutional direction or responsibility through the operating capability required for action. The governing standard is sovereign capacity: the institution retains the authority and knowledge required to govern and adapt the means on which that action depends.

## Pages

- [The firm](https://www.shiftora.ai/): The institutional thesis and the role Shiftora assumes.
- [Mandates](https://www.shiftora.ai/mandates): The institutional conditions that may give rise to a Shiftora mandate.
